description: Generate a PDF from a preview. Call with no args first: if multiple previews exist, returns needs_selection + previews (title + preview_id) — ask the user which one, then call again with preview_id. If only one preview exists, generates it immediately. Returns pdf_url when generated.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

preview_id.description: Unique preview_id from a prior preview_document result. Omit to list choices (when multiple) or generate the only/last preview.

name: pdf__generate_pdf
